FaultOrigin.TargetSubUnit: TLB Lookup; Tag Matching; ASID context
FaultOrigin.FaultType: False-positive ASID comparator on a normal TLB miss

Activation.EligibleEventCondition: Candidate valid; same VA range/N/regime/security/VMID; global=false; candidate ASID differs from current ASID.
Activation.ActualEligibleEvent: normal miss with same-VA candidate from another non-global ASID

NodesNotEmittedByFrozenBinary: commit (as an IFU-specific event; generic commit is emitted)
